name: NVDA vs AMD: Semiconductor Rivals Comparison
description: Comparative research study of NVDA and AMD covering price action (normalized cumulative returns rebased to 100), rolling 60-day correlation, drawdown time series, and key summary statistics (total return, annualized volatility, max drawdown, Sharpe ratio, full-period correlation).
source:
# =============================================================================
# NVDA vs AMD: SEMICONDUCTOR RIVALS COMPARISON
# =============================================================================
# Covers: price action, relative performance, correlation, drawdowns
#
# Chart 1 (cs_lines): Normalized cumulative returns rebased to 100
# Chart 2 (xy_lines): Rolling 60-day correlation of daily returns
# Chart 3 (cs_lines): Drawdown time series for both stocks
# Table  (cs_summary_table): Total return, annualized vol, max drawdown,
#         Sharpe ratio, full-period correlation
#
# Dataset: NVDA-Stocks, AMD-Stocks (primary), plus reference_stocks for
#          cross-asset correlation calculation
# =============================================================================

# --- Per-asset data (runs once per asset in universe) ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Daily returns for per-asset metrics
daily_ret = returns(period=1)(close)

# --- 1. Normalized cumulative returns (rebased to 100) ---
first_close = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(close)
norm_price = close / first_close * 100

# --- 2. Drawdowns per asset ---
peak = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(close)
drawdown = (close - peak) / peak

# --- 3. Rolling 60-day correlation (needs both assets explicitly) ---
nvda_o, nvda_h, nvda_l, nvda_c, nvda_v, nvda_vw, nvda_n = reference_stocks(ticker='NVDA')()
amd_o, amd_h, amd_l, amd_c, amd_v, amd_vw, amd_n = reference_stocks(ticker='AMD')()

nvda_close = ffill(nvda_c)
amd_close = ffill(amd_c)

nvda_ret = returns(period=1)(nvda_close)
amd_ret = returns(period=1)(amd_close)

corr_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=nvda_ret, y=amd_ret)

# Full-period expanding correlation for the summary table
full_corr = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=nvda_ret, y=amd_ret)

# --- 4. Summary statistics per asset ---
# Annualized volatility (252-day)
ann_vol = volatility(period=252)(close)

# Total return (cumulative)
total_ret = (close - first_close) / first_close

# Max drawdown (expanding min of drawdown series)
max_dd = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(drawdown)

# Sharpe ratio proxy: annualized return / annualized vol
# Annualized return from total return: (1 + total_ret)^(252/bar_count) - 1
# Simpler: use daily mean return * 252 / vol
daily_mean = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(daily_ret)
ann_ret = daily_mean * 252
sharpe = ann_ret / ann_vol

bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# Chart 1: Normalized cumulative returns (cs_lines — both on same chart)
cs_lines(
    title='Normalized Cumulative Returns (Rebased to 100)',
    category='1. Price Action & Relative Performance',
    y_axis_label='Indexed Price (Start = 100)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    order=1
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=norm_price)

# Chart 2: Rolling 60-day correlation (xy_lines — per-asset, same data)
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 60-Day Correlation (Returns-Based)',
    category='2. Correlation',
    y_axis_label='Pearson Correlation',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='0'),
        ReferenceLine(value=1, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Perfect +1')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NVDA–AMD 60d Correlation', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=corr_60d)

# Chart 3: Drawdown time series (cs_lines — both on same chart)
cs_lines(
    title='Drawdown From Peak',
    category='3. Drawdowns',
    y_axis_label='Drawdown',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    order=3
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=drawdown)

# Table: Key summary stats
cs_summary_table(
    title='Key Statistics',
    category='4. Summary',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Total Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Ann. Volatility', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Max Drawdown', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Sharpe Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Full-Period Corr.', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ],
        include_timestamp=False,
        title='Key Statistics'
    ),
    order=4
)(total_ret, ann_vol, max_dd, sharpe, full_corr)
